name: dsh-setup
description: DSH web profile template — the deployable profile lives in profiles/web/. This root manifest deliberately declares NO plugin dependencies. profiles/web/plugins.intent.json is the single source of intent; profiles/web/package.json and the allowBuilds block in pnpm-workspace.yaml are GENERATED from it by scripts/derive-profile.mjs. `pnpm test` runs four independent programs: (1) derive-profile --check asserts the generated artifacts still match the intent, (2) check-template asserts the template is self-consistent, (3) derive-profile.selftest mutates the intent and asserts every derive assertion fires, (4) check-template.selftest mutates the template and asserts every one of check-template's registered checks actually fires — a guard that cannot fail is not a guard.

scripts.test: node scripts/derive-profile.mjs && node scripts/check-template.mjs && node scripts/derive-profile.selftest.mjs && node scripts/check-template.selftest.mjs
